title: OAuth mTLS：存取 token 與用戶端憑證綁定
titleEn: OAuth mTLS: binding access tokens to client certificates
subcategoryTitle: 工作負載身分與聯邦信任驗證
summary: 列token簽章、issuer、audience、到期時間、cnf憑證指紋與TLS端呈現指紋六欄；先完成基本token驗證，再比較兩個指紋。
summaryEn: Record token signature result, issuer, audience, expiry, cnf certificate thumbprint and the certificate observed on TLS. Complete ordinary token validation before comparing the two thumbprints.

scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 綁定拒絕可能是換證但未換token，或代理傳遞錯誤憑證資訊；兩者在token的cnf與TLS現場指紋會留下不同關係。
將憑證輪替與綁定token換發納入同一變更計畫；暫存重試必須使用匹配的一對，不能為可用性關閉certificate-bound檢查。
RFC8705將存取token綁定用戶端憑證，以區分持有token與持有對應私鑰；本課以合成thumbprint驗證綁定鏈。
optionsEn: A binding rejection may reflect certificate renewal without token renewal or incorrect certificate evidence from a proxy. Comparing token cnf with transport-observed evidence distinguishes those relationships.
Coordinate certificate rotation with issuance of newly bound tokens. Retries must use a matching pair; availability pressure is not a reason to disable certificate-bound verification.

RFC8705 binds an access token to a client certificate, distinguishing possession of the token from possession of the corresponding private key. This case verifies that binding using synthetic thumbprints.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 憑證綁定不能取代TLS身分驗證或token受眾驗證；代理終止TLS時，後端看到的憑證資訊必須有可信傳遞契約，不能信任任意header。
knowledge.textEn: Certificate binding does not replace TLS authentication or token-audience validation. When a proxy terminates TLS, certificate evidence delivered to the backend needs a trusted propagation contract rather than an arbitrary client-controlled header.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: RFC8705將存取token綁定用戶端憑證，以區分持有token與持有對應私鑰；本課以合成thumbprint驗證綁定鏈。
knowledge.textEn: RFC8705 binds an access token to a client certificate, distinguishing possession of the token from possession of the corresponding private key. This case verifies that binding using synthetic thumbprints.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 列token簽章、issuer、audience、到期時間、cnf憑證指紋與TLS端呈現指紋六欄；先完成基本token驗證，再比較兩個指紋。
knowledge.textEn: Record token signature result, issuer, audience, expiry, cnf certificate thumbprint and the certificate observed on TLS. Complete ordinary token validation before comparing the two thumbprints.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 憑證綁定不能取代TLS身分驗證或token受眾驗證；代理終止TLS時，後端看到的憑證資訊必須有可信傳遞契約，不能信任任意header。
knowledge.textEn: Certificate binding does not replace TLS authentication or token-audience validation. When a proxy terminates TLS, certificate evidence delivered to the backend needs a trusted propagation contract rather than an arbitrary client-controlled header.

optionsEn: Certificate binding does not replace TLS authentication or token-audience validation. When a proxy terminates TLS, certificate evidence delivered to the backend needs a trusted propagation contract rather than an arbitrary client-controlled header.
